summary: Botanic Gardens visitor car park backing onto bush, no homes nearby.
reasons: Pin is in bush; real place is car park
Bush behind, gardens and planetarium around

best_section.where: Edge of the large car park east-south-east of the pin, beside the bush

drivers.seclusion: Bush on one side, gardens and car park around; nearest buildings are non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road and aisles reach the car park, with many marked bays.
drivers.traffic: Busy by day with visitors; quiet road beside it overnight.
drivers.convention: Public car park listed as free, no fee; many cars by day.

flags: Ring sits in thick bush on a steep slope (max 17.8%), so the pin is off
Gate 15 m from ring, mapped way round it
Gardens may close or be patrolled at night
sun_shade: Open asphalt with palms along the edge; bush shades the north-west side.
